Versatile and creative data professional with a unique background in research support, blending on-the-job expertise in technologies like Python and SQL with a rich humanistic education.

Experienced in investigating a wide array of analytic questions, ranging from company operational statistics to scientific publication trends and technical consultative support of research in fields like biomedical sciences, history, and sociology, typically working with PhD-level experts.

Demonstrated initiative in designing and implementing innovative technical solutions, such as: [library-lendable Arduino DIY-electronics kits for the Baton Rouge public](https://ebrpl.libguides.com/arduino/kitcontents); HTTP API-based intranet services for DOI management ([ESO](https://doi.eso.org/), [Brain Image Library](https://www.brainimagelibrary.org/)); a free, weekly drop-in tutoring service for R; and [agentic skills for searching and reporting on biomedical datasets](https://github.com/djbordelon/hubmap-data-search-skill).

Combining technical acumen with a strong client-focused approach, I am poised to bring a unique blend of creativity, empathy, and analytic skill to a dynamic Data Analyst, Data Curator, or Data Steward role.
